entries.mechanic: A weapon's attack rate: the attack time in integer milliseconds, floored after local increased attack speed, rate 1000 / ms (Q11); PoB rounds the base rate and the local rate to two decimals. The registered value also carries the skill's attack speed multiplier and global modifiers in PoB's order; it holds only if open question Q12 confirms that order.
evidence: In-game weapon tooltip, maintainer, 2026-11-12: Siege Axe (667 ms) with 15% increased attack speed shows 1.72; PoB's model gives round(1.50 x 1.15, 2) = 1.73. It shows the weapon's own rate only, and does not separate a floored from an unfloored attack time (both 1.7241) (docs/phase-3/attack-hits.md, "The switch")

Mark_GGG, Reddit questions thread 2020-01-29: weapons have an attack time in ms; 625 / 1.23 = 508 ms, rounded down to an integer value; attacks per second 1000 / ms, rounded only for the tooltip (https://devtrackers.gg/pathofexile/p/bc0f1173-questions-thread-january-29-2020)

This fixture's weapon has no local attack speed: the difference is the base rate 1000 / 667 = 1.4993 against PoB's exported round(1000 / 667, 2) = 1.50, supported by the tooltip (not PoB's 1.50 x 1.15) and the developer's 1000 / ms

entries.mechanic: An Abyss timeless jewel's per-minute regeneration roll (base_mana_regeneration_rate_per_minute on a replacement row): the results hold the stat's raw value per minute and the engine applies it so; PoB writes it into the replacement's text as round(value / 60, 1) per second and parses that text, so each roll moves to the nearest tenth per second.
evidence: PoB v2.67.2 Classes/PassiveSpec.lua 1202 to 1218 (replaceHelperFunc): a stat whose key has per_minute becomes round(value / 60, 1) before the text is parsed; the Abyss parts' rolls go through it (1221 to 1236)

PoB v2.67.2 Data/TimelessJewelData/AbyssAmanamu.zip, seed 7805 results, socket 41263: the replacement rows' rolls are whole per-minute values (51 on node 61320); the game's stat base_mana_regeneration_rate_per_minute is per minute (AlternatePassiveSkills, build 26530219), so 0.85 per second
docs/phase-6/recovery.md, "A display limit": the engine reads per-minute stats at their value; PoB reads the printed number

evidence: In-game weapon tooltip, maintainer, 2026-11-12: Siege Axe (667 ms) with 15% increased attack speed shows 1.72; PoB's model gives round(1.50 x 1.15, 2) = 1.73 (docs/phase-3/attack-hits.md, "The switch")

evidence: In-game weapon tooltip, maintainer, 2026-11-12: Siege Axe (667 ms) with 15% increased attack speed shows 1.72; PoB's model gives round(1.50 x 1.15, 2) = 1.73 (docs/phase-3/attack-hits.md, "The switch")

evidence: In-game weapon tooltip, maintainer, 2026-11-12: Siege Axe (667 ms) with 15% increased attack speed shows 1.72; PoB's model gives round(1.50 x 1.15, 2) = 1.73 (docs/phase-3/attack-hits.md, "The switch")

entries.mechanic: PoB's full DPS pass computes a skill with the player's base modifiers in a cached parent ModDB and the modifiers added during the calculation (buffs such as Blood and Sand's stance) in the pass's own ModDB; its main calculation holds both in one ModDB. ModDB:More rounds each level's product of more multipliers to 2 decimals, so the same skill's FullDPS differs from its own TotalDPS. The engine counts each included skill's own main calculation. The successor value also carries the registered Q11 attack rate (the fixture's Speed entry).
evidence: PoB v2.67.2 Modules/CalcSetup.lua 488 to 587: without cached databases (the main calculation) the base and config modifiers go into env.modDB itself; with them (Calcs.lua 425 and 335, calcFullDPS) env.modDB.parent = cachedPlayerDB
PoB v2.67.2 Classes/ModDB.lua 157 to 194, MoreInternal: result = result * round(product of the level's MORE mods, 2), then times the parent's MoreInternal

entries.mechanic: PoB's full DPS pass computes a skill with the player's base modifiers in a cached parent ModDB and the modifiers added during the calculation (buffs such as Blood and Sand's stance) in the pass's own ModDB; its main calculation holds both in one ModDB. ModDB:More rounds each level's product of more multipliers to 2 decimals, so the same skill's FullDPS differs from its own TotalDPS. The engine counts each included skill's own main calculation. The successor value also carries the registered Q11 attack rate (the fixture's Speed entry).
evidence: PoB v2.67.2 Modules/CalcSetup.lua 488 to 587: without cached databases (the main calculation) the base and config modifiers go into env.modDB itself; with them (Calcs.lua 425 and 335, calcFullDPS) env.modDB.parent = cachedPlayerDB
PoB v2.67.2 Classes/ModDB.lua 157 to 194, MoreInternal: result = result * round(product of the level's MORE mods, 2), then times the parent's MoreInternal

Instrumented PoB run (open items, agent list: Static Strike and Shockwave; the S4 probe of docs/phase-6/full-dps-levels.md on the build with Static Strike's group as the main group, each of its two skills as the main skill): every mod the same in both passes; Static Strike's Damage MORE 1.064 in its main pass and 1.06624 in full DPS (0.70 x round(1.36 x 1.12, 2) against 0.70 x 1.36 x 1.12: Rage's 36% more, added during the calculation, in the pass's own ModDB; 4% more per frenzy charge, three charges, Base, in the cached parent), Shockwave's 1.52 and 1.5232; PoB's own TotalDPS 66,115.66 and 30,578.76, its full DPS lines 66,252.77 and 30,649.97

entries.mechanic: PoB's two active effects of one gem (a Vaal gem's Vaal skill and its base variant) share the gem's saved instance, and each writes the minion it picked there; every later environment reads the second effect's choice for the first when the first's minion list has it. So PoB's full DPS of Vaal Summon Skeletons of Mages counts the Skeleton Caster (the base variant's only minion), while its main output (the Calcs view, skillMinionCalcs) counts the build's default, the melee skeleton. The engine counts the skill's own minion, as its main calculation does. The successor value also carries the registered minion level (DIV-0124, the minion's TotalDPS).
evidence: PoB v2.67.2 Modules/Data.lua 1098 to 1118: a Vaal gem's AltX and AltY variants keep the Vaal skill (VaalSummonSkeletons: melee, caster, archer) as the first effect and the base variant (SummonSkeletonsAltY: the caster only) as the second

PoB v2.67.2 Modules/CalcActiveSkill.lua 682 to 692: each effect's minion is minionList[index of srcInstance.skillMinion or 1], written back to srcInstance.skillMinion (skillMinionCalcs for the main skill in the Calcs view); both effects' srcInstance is the gem

Instrumented PoB run (the agent list; the probe and its output committed in docs/phase-6/minions.md, "Vaal Summon Skeletons' full DPS"): after the first calculation the gem holds skillMinion=RaisedSkeletonCaster and skillMinionCalcs=RaisedSkeletonMeleeVaal, though the fixture saves neither; the MAIN and full DPS passes compute the Vaal skill with the caster, minion TotalDPS 416.996; the main output's minion TotalDPS is 115.298
